text:
violet: Quick note from today's bring-up: candidate rnrk-v6-int8 passed coarse NDCG checks but shows a consistent ~3.5% top-1 MRR regression on a narrow slice: short Qs where docs interleave numbered steps + inline code + URLs.
noah: Can you paste one minimal repro pair?
violet: Sure. From holdout:
```
query: "set up github pages with custom domain"
fp16_doc: "Steps:
1. create repo
2. enable github pages under settings
3. add CNAME file containing `example.com`
See https://docs.github.com/pages for details." -> rank 1

ptq_doc: "To set up pages, create repo and enable pages. Example CNAME: `example.com`
More info: https://docs.github.com/pages
Note: push to branch gh-pages." -> drops to rank 2 on int8
```
ranjit: Hmm, those seem extremely similar. Any token differences?
violet: Token delta small overall but tokenization around the backtick+URL area differs. fp16 tokens include explicit backtick and separate `example` and `.com`, int8 packaging merged into a single token for the inline code+dot sequence.
noah: Packaging step — did we bundle tokenizer binary and config with the quantized artifact? Any sha mismatches in the build log?
violet: Build log shows tokenizer v3.0.2 packaged, runtime image is v3.0.2, but quantization was done on a worker that had a local patch to the token merge rules (long story). So there's a subtle tokenizer divergence during calib.
ci-bot: :robot_face: queued diag job 5321110000-token-parity: ./tools/tokenizer_diff --model rnrk-v6-int8 --slice short-steps-code --samples 1200 --out /tmp/td-5321110000
ranjit: Also could be attention head scaling: when punctuation tokens collapse the positional alignment of KV cache changes, heads focused on punctuation might underflow after quantization. We should dump head-wise norms for a few failures.
violet: I dumped one case: head norms fp16 -> [0.42,0.11,0.08,0.30,...] vs int8 -> [0.39,0.03,0.02,0.28,...]. Head 2/3 collapsed significantly.
noah: That points at either per-tensor quant scale being too coarse or a bad calibration dataset. What was calib sample selection? random 1k from production?
violet: Calib used 2k random docs from training mix; but the short-steps-code slice is rare so calibration didn't emphasize punctuation/code tokens.
ranjit: Action plan: 1) run per-head (per-channel) calibration with a stratified sample that includes more short-steps-code docs; 2) add a tokenizer-parity check in packaging; 3) add normalization preproc option that spaces punctuation around backticks/urls for onboarding fastfix; 4) curate a focused golden slice (500 items) for CI asserting top1 MRR delta <= 1.5%.
ci-bot: :robot_face: queued job 5321110000-calib-per-head: ./quant --model rnrk-v6 --calib per_head --samples 2500 --strata short-steps-code=600 --out /artifacts/5321110000
noah: Also run a hybrid eval where attention remains fp16 but MLP quantized, to check if the scoring shift localizes to attention.
ci-bot: queued job 5321110000-hybrid-eval: ./eval --model rnrk-v6-hybrid --slice short-steps-code --samples 1200
violet: Local quick tests: int8 + add-space-normalize recovered ~2.1% of top1 MRR; hybrid recovered ~3.0%; per-head calib result pending.
ranjit: If per-head calib closes the rest, we'll prefer that recipe. If not, add the normalize preproc to onboarding pipeline as a stopgap.
noah: Can someone curate the golden 500 and open a PR that adds it to the model-onboard CI with a small runner? Make the CI lightweight (samples run in parallel on small machines).
violet: I'll curate and open PR. Will include a short doc describing slices (inline-code, numbered steps, short urls) and a simple tokenizer-diff unit test. Tagging @ranjit and @harper for review.
ci-bot: :white_check_mark: job 5321110000-token-parity completed. Found 14 tokenizer mismatches (mostly inline-code merges). Report uploaded: https://redwood.internal/tdiff/5321110000
ranjit: Great. I'll start the per-head calib PR and attach head-norm plots for the worst 20 cases. If head collapse persists after per-head calib we may try a hybrid quant strategy (attn fp16, rest int8) as a mitigation.
noah: Let's also add a step to the onboarding checklist: 'verify tokenization parity on formatting-heavy slices (code/tables/numbered steps) before finalizing quantized weights'.
violet: Will update checklist in the PR. Closing loop after per-head results and PR merges. Thanks everyone!
